items.question: What file formats does SuSa Analyzer support?
items.answer: SuSa Analyzer supports Excel files (.xlsx, .xls) containing your Summen und Salden data. The system automatically detects and categorizes account structures.

items.question: What 3D formats can I upload?
items.answer: The 3D Viewer supports GLB and GLTF formats. We recommend GLB for best compatibility. Maximum file size is 100 MB.

items.question: How is my data secured?
items.answer: All data is encrypted in transit (TLS) and at rest. Files are stored securely and only accessible to your account. We are GDPR compliant.

items.question: Can I share reports with colleagues?
items.answer: Yes! You can export reports as PDF, Excel, or CSV and share them via email or other channels. Team collaboration features are on our roadmap.

items.question: What languages are supported?
items.answer: The platform is available in English and German. More languages may be added based on demand.

items.question: Is there an API available?
items.answer: A public API is planned for future releases. Contact us if you have specific integration requirements.
